svg.title: Harbour entrance beacon — Innsiglingarviti
svg.desc: An open lattice harbour beacon supports a lantern room above braced legs, with side light rays.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"fisheries-harbour-beacon","label_en":"Harbour entrance beacon","label_is":"Innsiglingarviti","section":"03","category_en":"Fisheries services, ports and cold logistics","category_is":"Þjónusta við sjávarútveg, hafnir og kælikeðja","batch":2,"tags":["fisheries","navigation"],"description":"An open lattice harbour beacon supports a lantern room above braced legs, with side light rays.","design_note":"An open braced frame and lantern distinguish this metal harbour beacon from the solid coastal lighthouse.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
